brief: The canvas displays an array of bioluminescent forms suspended in darkness. These shapes constantly pulse and drift, emanating visible, glowing smoke tails. The forms cycle through colors, subtly shifting between blue and deep purple. The smoky tails are highly interactive: they gather into visible clusters and can momentarily form glowing bridges of light when they pass near other forms. Furthermore, the tails ripple with visible, rhythmic pulses, giving the entire field a dynamic, self-sustaining life.

statement: This sketch creates an immersive field of bioluminescent forms that drift and pulse in darkness. Each form gently moves across the canvas, leaving glowing smoke-like tails behind them. The forms cycle through subtle color shifts between deep blue and purple, with pulsing effects that make them appear to breathe. The interactive elements include the smoke tails that gather into visible clusters and can momentarily form glowing bridges of light when they pass near other forms. These connections ripple with rhythmic pulses, creating a dynamic, self-sustaining ecosystem of light that moves organically across the screen without any user input.
